comparisons.topic: ChatGPT Business vs Claude Team for everyday work
comparisons.angle: Both are general AI assistants for a small team. Compare seat minimums (2 vs 5), price per seat, and app integrations — not just 'which AI is smarter.'

comparisons.topic: Tidio vs Freshdesk Freddy AI for customer support
comparisons.angle: Tidio is a lightweight website chat widget; Freshdesk is a full help desk with AI ticket resolution. Compare for a business with a handful of pre-sale questions vs one running a real support queue.

comparisons.topic: Dialpad Ai vs Nextiva for a business phone system
comparisons.angle: Both add AI call summaries to a VoIP phone system. Compare entry pricing and whether you need contact-center features or just a smarter phone line.

comparisons.topic: HeyGen vs Descript for making video content without a videographer
comparisons.angle: HeyGen generates avatar-presenter video from a script; Descript edits real footage by editing the transcript. Compare for someone who doesn't want to be on camera vs someone who films but hates editing.

comparisons.topic: HubSpot Breeze AI vs folk for a small business CRM
comparisons.angle: HubSpot is a full AI-powered marketing/sales platform; folk is a lightweight CRM that auto-builds contacts from your inbox. Compare cost and setup effort for a 1-5 person team.

comparisons.topic: Fathom vs Loom for capturing meetings and communicating async
comparisons.angle: Fathom auto-transcribes and summarizes live calls; Loom records a video message you send instead of a live call. Compare for 'notes from a meeting that already happened' vs 'skip the meeting entirely.'
